highlights: Transpiled Python-based prediction scripts into C++ and distributable binaries, achieving a speedup of 1.6X for property predictions made using on-premises infrastructure.

Automated production backup testing and restoration using Terraform, increasing testing coverage from less than 1% of platform data to 100% and achieving a recovery time of under 20 minutes.
